versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- Removed unused test files to simplify the codebase.
- Updated documentation in CHANGELOG.md and SKILL.md for clarity and version alignment.
- Refined clawhub.json and strategy.py for internal consistency.
- No changes to exit or entry logic; production strategy remains the same.

Version 1.2.3 – Documentation update only

- Removed the "Oracle-Engineering Halt Gate" section from documentation; this skill never used the detector and does not trade the short-duration markets that section targeted.
- No code changes or behavior modifications.

polymarket-btc-up-down-trader v1.2.2

- Fixed position accounting: Live NO entries now log entry price in YES-scale (`avg_cost` held-side), enabling correct `target_hit` detection for both YES and NO sides.
- Replay rows (backtests) are unaffected; no change to their data structure/handling.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) for new position handling details.
- Added unit test for replay plane compatibility.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.

## Version 1.1.0 – Changelog

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for improved clarity and detail.
- Removed skill-card.md for streamlined project structure.
- General maintenance and minor fixes across key files.
- No core logic changes to strategy or algorithmic behavior.
Fix live mode to execute entries and exits through SimmerClient.trade() instead of nonexistent buy()/sell() methods.

- Improved documentation for setup, configuration, and usage.
- Added detailed explanations of entry and exit logic, including new FAQ and troubleshooting.
- Clarified intended use for daily/weekly BTC UP/DOWN markets vs. fast markets.
- Provided sample configurations and CLI usage examples for convenience.
- Outlined Polymarket fee structure and trading considerations in more depth.
